features.name: Lake Roland Dam
features.description: Lake Roland Dam is the historic stone-and-earth waterworks structure at the lake's south end, viewed from the developed central park and paved-loop area.

details.positionQuality: Photographed public viewpoint of Lake Roland Dam
details.coordinateSource: Wikimedia Commons photograph GPS reviewed against OpenStreetMap dam way 62642580
details.imageAlt: Lake Roland Dam at Lake Roland Park

features.name: Lake Roland Waterworks
features.description: The Lake Roland Waterworks is the named 1861 service building beside the dam, a surviving piece of Baltimore's first municipal water-supply landscape.

features.name: White Trail
features.description: White Trail is an approximately 0.3-mile hiking-only connector through Lake Roland's serpentine area, with exposed rock, roots and weather-sensitive natural footing.
